checks.label: references
checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),a=require('assert'),h=require('crypto'),c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('doneaudit.config.json','utf8'));for(const p of c.context.references){a(!p.includes('..')&&!p.startsWith('/'),'unsafe reference');a(fs.existsSync(p),'missing '+p)}const t=fs.readFileSync(c.context.handoff,'utf8');for(const f of ['CURRENT_GOAL','CURRENT_BRANCH','CURRENT_HEAD','LAST_VERIFIED_STATE','COMPLETED','ACTIVE_WORK','LOCKED_DECISIONS','KNOWN_BLOCKERS','EVENT_PENDING','UNVERIFIED','NEXT_SINGLE_ACTION'])a(t.includes(f),'missing field '+f);const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.doneaudit/tool/doneaudit-install.json','utf8'));a.equal(m.sourceRevision,c.context.sourcePin);for(const [p,v]of Object.entries(c.context.toolHashes)){a.equal(h.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync('.doneaudit/tool/'+p)).digest('hex'),v,'tool drift '+p);a.equal(m.files[p],v)}const s=fs.readFileSync('AGENTS.md','utf8');a.equal(s.split('<!-- doneaudit:start -->').length,2);a.equal(s.split('<!-- doneaudit:end -->').length,2);console.log('References, handoff fields, single owned rule and pinned tool bytes checked; not product acceptance')"

checks.label: scope
checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),a=require('assert'),cp=require('child_process'),c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('doneaudit.config.json','utf8'));const changed=[...cp.execFileSync('git',['diff','--name-only','-z',c.context.baseline,'--'],{encoding:'utf8'}).split('\0'),...cp.execFileSync('git',['ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z'],{encoding:'utf8'}).split('\0')].filter(Boolean);for(const p of changed)a(c.context.allowedPaths.includes(p),'outside governance scope: '+p);a(changed.length>0,'no integration diff to validate');console.log('Exact governance allowlist checked: '+changed.length+' paths; product runtime unchanged by this delta')"
